milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron bars form a 3-wide metallic grid gateway in the stone brick wall at spawn-relative z=5 and z=10, centered at (0, 1, 7). The player must be within 8 blocks and facing toward the bars (±60°). From spawn (~7 blocks away), the bars are clearly visible (confirmed in screenshot), so early triggering when facing correctly is acceptable — the player genuinely 'found' them.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The crimson door is placed at spawn-relative (0, 1, 14) on the front face of the nether brick building, behind the iron bars corridor. max_distance=10 requires the player to walk forward at least ~4 blocks from spawn (total distance from spawn is ~14 blocks), ensuring they navigate past the iron bars area before this milestone can trigger. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the door.
